samples.xml_description:
<module id="barrel_shifter">
    <description>A barrel shifter for rotating bits efficiently. This 8-bit barrel shifter takes an 8-bit input and shifts or rotates the bits based on a 3-bit control signal.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input to be shifted.</input>
        <input id="ctrl" width_description="[2:0]">3-bit control signal that determines how many positions to shift.</input>
        <output id="out" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit shifted output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>The barrel shifter shifts the input 'in' based on the value of the 'ctrl' signal. The shifting happens in stages, where each stage shifts by 4, 2, or 1 position, as controlled by 'ctrl[2]', 'ctrl[1]', and 'ctrl[0]', respectively. The shifts are achieved using a series of 2-to-1 multiplexers ('mux2X1') that select between the shifted input and the original input. Each stage of multiplexers performs the shift, and the result is passed to the next stage for further shifting if required.</implementation>
</module>
